entries.title: Proverbs 11:1
segments: A false balance is an abomination to Jehovah; But a just weight is his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:2
segments: When pride cometh, then cometh shame; But with the lowly is wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:3
segments: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; But the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:4
segments: Riches profit not in the day of wrath; But righteousness delivereth from death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:5
segments: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way; But the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:6
segments: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them; But the treacherous shall be taken in their own iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:7
segments: When a wicked man dieth, [his] expectation shall perish; And the hope of iniquity perisheth.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:8
segments: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, And the wicked cometh in his stead.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:9
segments: With his mouth the godless man destroyeth his neighbor; But through knowledge shall the righteous be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:10
segments: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth; And when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:11
segments: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted; But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:12
segments: He that despiseth his neighbor is void of wisdom; But a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:13
segments: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth a matter.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:14
segments: Where no wise guidance is, the people falleth; But in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:15
segments: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it; But he that hateth suretyship is secure.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:16
segments: A gracious woman obtaineth honor; And violent men obtain riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:17
segments: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul; But he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:18
segments: The wicked earneth deceitful wages; But he that soweth righteousness [hath] a sure reward.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:19
segments: He that is stedfast in righteousness [shall attain] unto life; And he that pursueth evil [doeth it] to his own death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:20
segments: They that are perverse in heart are an abomination to Jehovah; But such as are perfect in [their] way are his delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:21
segments: [Though] hand [join] in hand, the evil man shall not be unpunished; But the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:22
segments: [As] a ring of gold in a swine's snout, [So is] a fair woman that is without discretion.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:23
segments: The desire of the righteous is only good; [But] the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:24
segments: There is that scattereth, and increaseth yet more; And there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but [it tendeth] only to want.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:25
segments: The liberal soul shall be made fat; And he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:26
segments: He that withholdeth grain, the people shall curse him; But blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:27
segments: He that diligently seeketh good seeketh favor; But he that searcheth after evil, it shall come unto him.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:28
segments: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; But the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:29
segments: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind; And the foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:30
segments: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; And he that is wise winneth souls.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:31
segments: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: How much more the wicked and the sinner!
